messages.subject: omitting port 3838 from the URL
parts:
Hello!

Is there a way to avoid putting 3838 in the URL of a shinyapp that we're hosting on a shiny server? I know that shinyapps.io somehow avoids this need to specify a port number and it would be easier for users to remember & share with colleagues.

Thanks,
James Dalgleish
NIH/NCI
